yeschoyDesktopRecovery.startObserved: Settings are saved and the operating system has observed the app starting. This does not verify that loading, sign-in, or model connectivity has completed. Check actual use inside the app.
yeschoyDesktopRecovery.opening: Opening the app; startup is not confirmed yet…
yeschoyDesktopRecovery.checkingStart: Checking startup; keeping the previous settings until this finishes…
yeschoyDesktopRecovery.retryHint: The assistant recovers unfinished changes first and asks you to save before restarting. You do not need to edit configuration files or find processes.
yeschoyDesktopRecovery.desktop_start_failed_restored: Startup could not be confirmed with the new settings. The previous settings were restored and the app reopened. This model change did not take effect; you can retry.
yeschoyDesktopRecovery.desktop_change_failed_restored: The update was cancelled or could not complete. The previous settings were restored and the app reopened. This model change did not take effect; you can retry.
yeschoyDesktopRecovery.previous_app_reopen_failed: The previous settings and key were restored, but startup still could not be confirmed. Handle any operating-system permission prompt, then select Repair and retry. No manual configuration editing is needed.
yeschoyDesktopRecovery.desktop_recovery_waiting_for_exit: The operating system has not allowed the app to close, so settings have not been restored. The recovery record is retained to avoid overwriting configuration still in use. Save your work, handle any system prompt, then select Repair and retry.
yeschoyDesktopRecovery.previous_connection_runtime_failed: Settings and the key were restored, but the previous local connection could not restart. Select Repair and retry. No manual configuration editing is needed.
yeschoyDesktopRecovery.configuration_rollback_failed: Recovery found changed or unwritable settings. Some settings remain unrestored; other changes were not forcibly overwritten. Select Repair and retry instead of editing configuration files.
yeschoyDesktopRecovery.credential_restore_failed: The key has not been restored. Unlock the system keychain or credential manager, then select Repair and retry.
yeschoyDesktopRecovery.recovery_receipt_failed: The recovery record could not be saved safely, so completion is unconfirmed. Select Repair and retry to recover the unfinished operation first.

yeschoyDiagnostics.title: Check your connection
yeschoyDiagnostics.description: Check this computer's connection to both lines layer by layer to pinpoint network problems.
yeschoyDiagnostics.scopeDns: Find the network address of each line
yeschoyDiagnostics.scopeTls: Verify the certificate chain and validity
yeschoyDiagnostics.scopeApiKey: Check the saved session (read-only, no charges incurred)
yeschoyDiagnostics.scopeNoApi: No conversations sent or model charges incurred
yeschoyDiagnostics.consent: The check connects only when you start it. If you are signed in, it verifies the key with the local session without incurring model charges.

reason.dns_resolved: The line's network address was found.
reason.dns_resolution_failed: The line address could not be found. Check your network and try again.
reason.dns_lookup_timed_out: The address lookup timed out. Try again later.
reason.tcp443_reachable: A basic connection to the line was established.
reason.tcp_connection_failed: The line address was found, but the connection failed. Try again later or use the other line.
reason.tcp_connect_timed_out: The connection attempt timed out. Use the other line or try again later.
reason.tls_handshake_verified: The certificate chain and validity were verified.
reason.tls_certificate_invalid: The certificate check failed. Check the system clock and proxy settings.
reason.tls_handshake_failed: The TLS handshake failed. Try again later.
reason.tls_handshake_timed_out: The TLS handshake timed out. Try again later.
reason.session_token_valid: The saved session is still valid.
reason.session_token_rejected: The saved session is no longer valid. Sign in again.
reason.api_probe_error: Key validity could not be verified right now. Try again.
reason.skipped_upstream_failed: Skipped because an upstream check failed.
reason.skipped_no_saved_session: Skipped because no session is saved.
reason.session_probe_unavailable: Skipped because the local session could not be read.

yeschoyDiagnostics.noResult: Run the check to see this computer's current result
yeschoyDiagnostics.disclaimerTitle: A connection does not guarantee model availability
yeschoyDiagnostics.disclaimerBody: This checks the network and session validity only, not model availability, response speed or account balance.
yeschoyDiagnostics.notRetained: Not kept after leaving this page

advanced.hint: For troubleshooting and migration. Collapsed by default; view-only.

yeschoyUpdate.title: Yeschoy automatic updates
yeschoyUpdate.body: Checks after startup and only alerts you when a release is ready. Model setup and app downloads stay independent.

phase.idle: Waiting for the first automatic check
phase.restarting: Finishing local work and restarting safely
phase.unavailable: Updates cannot be checked right now

reason.idle: No action needed. Yeschoy will check in the background.
reason.checking: Only the Yeschoy update source is contacted; model and account settings are not read.
reason.update_available: The package is verified before Yeschoy exits and restarts.
reason.downloading: You can keep browsing; the updater does not hold the app-setup lock.
reason.preparing_restart: Waiting for local work to finish safely.
reason.channel_unavailable: The update source is temporarily unavailable. Other features still work.
reason.native_unavailable: The local update service did not respond. Other features still work.
reason.response_timeout: The check took too long and stopped waiting. Other features remain available.
reason.install_failed_restarted: The previous install did not finish. The existing version was reopened and settings were preserved.
reason.signature_invalid: The package failed signature verification and was not installed.
reason.download_failed: The download did not finish. You can retry later.
reason.artifact_invalid: The update package was not valid and was not installed.
reason.stale_version: Release information changed. Check again before updating.
reason.update_not_checked: Check for an update before installing.
reason.shutting_down: Yeschoy is closing, so this update stopped.
reason.shutdown_failed: Local work could not finish safely. The existing version was reopened.
reason.install_failed: Installation did not finish. The existing version was reopened.
reason.updater_not_configured: This build has no configured update channel.
reason.platform_unsupported: Automatic updates are not supported on this system yet.
reason.endpoint_invalid: The update address failed its security check.
reason.manifest_invalid: The release manifest is incomplete or not for this computer.
reason.check_failed: The check could not finish. Other features are unaffected.
reason.default: Updates and model setup are independent; an update failure cannot lock the app.

yeschoyUpdate.safety: Every package must pass signature verification. Yeschoy stays open until download completes and never changes Codex, Claude, or other app settings during an update.
